reviewers.summary: Shell meets all owned requirements (server page + single client boundary, state ownership, pure synchronous results gate, responsive layout, a11y) with passing lint/build/44 tests; three low, mostly-latent issues — all resolved.

findings.summary: isRoomValid checked the min length on the trimmed name but the max on the untrimmed value, so a <=50-char name padded with whitespace was wrongly rejected. Latent now (only DEFAULT_STATE validated) but ships into room editing (change 6).
findings.recommendation: Validate both bounds against the trimmed name.

findings.summary: The results <section> landmark was labelled t('perRoom') ('Per-room results'), but the region will hold the module summary, band diagram, per-room cards AND visualizer — mislabelling the landmark for screen-reader navigation.
findings.recommendation: Add a generic 'results' key and label the region with it; reserve perRoom for its subsection.

findings.summary: The sticky input column used a hardcoded lg:top-[67px] decoupled from the derived header height; a header padding/typography change would silently misalign it.
findings.recommendation: Derive the offset from a shared header-height token.

reviewers.summary: openspec validate app-shell --strict: PASS (0 issues). All owned IDs implemented + covered (page.tsx Server Component renders single <Calculator/>; Calculator owns AppState + derives showResults via useMemo; pure synchronous gate unit-tested incl. purity; responsive grid; LanguageToggle top-right; aria-live results; focus/label a11y). No forward scope drift (input/results are empty slots — no apartment fields/room CRUD/result sections/mode toggle). ThemeToggle + themeLight/themeDark keys are acceptable DESIGN §4 header furniture owned by tasks §6; EN/UA parity preserved; no new dependency. 44/44 tests pass.

Holds all privacy/security constraints: no persistence (localStorage/sessionStorage/cookie/indexedDB), no network/analytics, ThemeToggle is in-memory useState setting html[data-theme] to a fixed literal (no attribute injection), all strings render as auto-escaped JSX from static dictionaries (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML/eval/URL sinks), package.json/lockfile unchanged, Server page renders only <Calculator/> with no props/secrets/server-actions (TC-DATA-01/BC-PRIVACY-01/BC-SCOPE-01 upheld).
